title: Set up a GenAI prompt
summary: put a one-click AI command on the sales order line screen that drafts a delivery update for the customer, check its answer against what LN shows, improve it one rule at a time, and take it away again.

tokens.v: A prompt is tied to one exact session code, and its dataset to that session's table. So the build starts on the screen the command will sit on, not in the setup sessions. LN has no language model of its own: it keeps a list retrieved from the Infor GenAI application, and a prompt that names no model uses the one that service marks as default.

blocks.text: What LN is doing. A prompt is tied to one exact session code, and its dataset to that session's table. tokens.v: A dataset is the LN data that travels with the question, and it is the whole of what the model is told. It starts from one main table and one index of it. The record the user is on reaches the dataset through that index, which is why both have to be the screen's own. Every field ticked is sent, so the first version takes only what the first prompt text names.

phases.title: Run it and check the answer

tokens.v: When the command is chosen, LN runs the dataset for the line on the form, writes the result into the prompt text and sends it to the model. The answer opens in a window of its own. The model answers only from what the dataset sent, and a wrong answer looks the same as a right one, so the first runs are checked against the form, once for each kind of line the prompt can meet.
